- Land use planning rules (R3 - Real Estate Markets, Spatial Production Analysis, and Firm Location)
- The planning/regulatory framework governing development decisions (R5 - Regional Government Analysis)
- Transit-oriented development around rail stations (R4 - Transportation Economics)

The primary classification is clearly **R** (Urban, Rural, Regional, Real Estate, and Transportation Economics). The rail station component adds a transportation dimension (R4), but this is secondary to the land use planning framework.
